name: Wash N Wax

features.text: A super thick, highly concentrated liquid soap.
Thick dense foam lifts dirt from the surface of the vehicle.
Contains real wax that leaves a luster to the paint.

description: A high-foaming car shampoo combined with wax that gently cleans a vehicle's exterior while leaving a shiny finish. The mild formula removes dirt, road film and other surface contaminants without stripping any existing wax finish.
application: DIRECTIONS: FOR BEST RESULTS, SURFACE SHOULD BE COOL AND OUT OF DIRECT SUNLIGHT. 1) Dilute 2 to 4 ounces of product with 1 gallon of water. 2) Rinse exterior of vehicle thoroughly. 3) Apply diluted solution generously with a wash mitt, sponge, or soft cloth. 4) Rinse well with clean water. 5) Thoroughly dry vehicle with either a clean chamois or clean, soft towel. As with any car polish, wax or sealant, pre-test on an inconspicuous area prior to applying to entire section.
review: Has a Performance Ratings section: Foaming - 9 Concentration - 9
